feature: Size measurement: ] stays on real objects, and a corner drag measures again
summary: Pressing ] from a measured pill no longer jumps to a box that runs from the pill into the small print under it. A picked Size measurement now shows its handles on the area it measured, so dragging a corner moves that corner where your hand lets go and the calipers read the new size.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no switch changed from its default. Open your download page capture, or Tests/PhotonzRenderTests/Fixtures/download-pill-2x.png. Walk: Scripts/playtest/size-steps-and-resizes-walk.json.

try.do: Press I, pick Size, hover the left end of the purple pill and press ].
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Click: it measures the pill, 274 by 62, not 279 by 90.
Press V and click the Size 274 × 62 row in Layers.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Drag the bottom right handle down and right.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

try.do: Press Cmd-Z: the measurement goes back to 274 by 62.
Option-drag the box down: the copy lands where you let go.
try.shotNote: Photographed with the window behind another app, the way a walk leaves it. Blue buttons and picked controls show their background look here; with the window in front they take the accent colour.

evaluate: Is ] doing nothing on the pill right, or would you want it to reach the pill and the line under it together?
Do handles on the measured area, with the calipers outside them, read as the measurement you picked?
After a corner drag, is it clear the numbers are now the box you drew rather than anything in the picture?
Should a corner drag snap to the picture's edges the way a fresh Size click does?
rough: No mock covers stepping or resizing a Size measurement; this changes what is measured, not how anything looks.
From the pill, ] now holds on the pill: nothing bigger in this crop is one object. It does not offer the pill and its small print together as a stack.
The turn knob and its arrows sit over the picked measurement, as they do for every picked group.
An Option-drag copy is named Size 274 × 62 copy, and that name stops following its numbers when the copy is resized (a-copied-size-measurement-keeps-saying-its-own-s).
